title: MicroBT: Centroid-Guided Synergistic Learning for Multi-Modal Micro Brain Tumor Segmentation and Counting
abstract: arXiv:2611.13912v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-modal brain tumor segmentation is essential for clinical diagnosis, radiotherapy planning, and longitudinal monitoring. While recent studies have achieved remarkable overall segmentation performance, they rely on overlap-based objectives that inherently favor large regions, causing sub-3 mm micro-lesions to be systematically suppressed during training. Moreover, existing pixel-level segmentation frameworks lack explicit instance-level modeling, leading to unreliable lesion counting that directly impacts clinical staging and therapeutic decisions. To address these challenges, we propose MicroBT, a unified multi-modal framework for micro brain tumor segmentation and counting. Our core insight is that a fundamental geometric property is inherently scale-invariant: regardless of size, each lesion possesses a well-defined centroid. translated_title: MicroBT：面向多模态微型脑肿瘤分割与计数的质心引导协同学习
translated_abstract: 多模态脑肿瘤分割对于临床诊断、放疗规划以及纵向监测至关重要。尽管近期研究已取得显著的总体分割性能，但它们依赖基于重叠度的优化目标，这类目标天然偏向大区域，导致小于3毫米的微小病灶在训练过程中被系统性抑制。此外，现有的像素级分割框架缺乏显式的实例级建模，导致病灶计数不可靠，而计数结果直接影响临床分期与治疗决策。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了MicroBT，一个用于微型脑肿瘤分割与计数的统一多模态框架。我们的核心洞察是一种基本几何属性具有天然的尺度不变性：无论大小如何，每个病灶都拥有明确定义的质心。基于这一洞察，我们首先设计了一种质心锚定的协同范式，利用预测的质心……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MicroBT统一框架，巧妙利用“病灶质心具有尺度不变性”这一几何特性，通过质心锚定的协同学习范式，解决多模态脑肿瘤分割中小于3毫米微小病灶被抑制以及病灶计数不可靠的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MicroBT, a unified multi-modal framework that exploits the inherent scale-invariance of lesion centroids via a centroid-anchored synergistic learning paradigm, addressing the systematic suppression of sub-3mm micro-lesions and unreliable lesion counting in brain tumor segmentation.
